title: Mixed Operations and Estimation
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through mixed operations and estimation.
definition: Use brackets first, then multiplication and division left to right, then addition and subtraction left to right. Estimation uses rounded numbers to approximate a result and check its size.

exercises.question: Estimate 4,189 + 7,634 by rounding each to nearest thousand.
Estimate 49 × 21 by rounding each to nearest ten.
